description: Autonomous CAPTCHA-BypassClaw skill. When visual CAPTCHAs become too heavily obfuscated for standard solvers, this agent intercepts the DOM and automatically pivots to the Audio CAPTCHA challenge. It streams the audio byte-buffer directly to a speech-to-text model (like Whisper) and injects the text back into the DOM.
